title: Long-command watchers
summary: A wrapper keeps every line in its raw capture and writes wake-worthy lines to its progress capture. yoke watch tail wakes its reader only on failures, refusals, decision-needing waits, terminal outcomes and the exit sentinel; routine digests and stall notices ride in front of the next such line, so a bare tail needs no filter. Watchers load runtime modules before starting the child, so terminal reporting and liveness retain the loaded code while the source changes; installed commands lease an immutable CLI release.
